name: dev-pipeline-orchestrator
description: Orchestrate the full development pipeline from idea to merged branch — clarify intent, write a test-driven bite-sized task plan, execute via focused subagents with two-stage review gates, verify with real evidence, then integrate.

displayDescription.en: Orchestrates the full development pipeline from requirement to delivery: clarifies intent before building, decomposes specs into test-driven bite-sized tasks, executes each via focused subagents gated by spec and quality reviews, verifies with real evidence, then integrates the finished branch.
displayDescription.zh: 编排开发流水线：澄清需求意图，拆解为测试驱动的细粒度任务，子代理逐任务实现并双重评审，最终集成分支。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me take this feature from idea to merged branch through a disciplined pipeline
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这个功能从想法推进到合并入主干，走完整的开发流水线

quickPrompts.en: Help me take this feature from idea to merged branch through a disciplined pipeline
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这个功能从想法推进到合并入主干，走完整的开发流水线

quickPrompts.en: Turn this spec into a test-driven, bite-sized task plan with exact files and code
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份需求拆成测试驱动的细粒度任务计划，含精确文件路径与完整代码

quickPrompts.en: Execute this plan task-by-task with a fresh subagent and two-stage review per task
quickPrompts.zh: 逐任务派子代理执行这份计划，每个任务过规格与质量双门评审
